where: Farlamp Sound, the Shelfwater and the Fogwall: rowing a small lamp-boat over the open deep sea towards a far blinking lamp
mood: Rowing on a long swell in the fog: the isles' hymn as a lone line over the sea.
_motif_note: Conditioned high on motif-farlamp.json: the sea rung of the family, the hymn as a lone line.
_stall_note: open sea between phrases: a held hush of surf is part of the cue
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
3/4 time, a slow rocking rowing pulse like oars on a long swell
a lone soft pulse-wave lead playing a slow seafaring hymn tune with space between phrases
a gently rocking plucked bass like oar strokes
one soft glass bell blinking every two bars like a far lighthouse
a very soft sampled string pad
lonely, wide open sea at dusk in the fog, steady and hopeful

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {surf rises and falls, the bass begins its rocking oar stroke, and a single far bell blinks}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the hymn tune as a lone pulse-wave line over the rocking oars in D Dorian, long held notes, the far bell blinking every two bars}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the tune again, a distant flute answering from far across the water, the strings breathing in under the swell}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: the fog thickens, the line drifts into F major and back, the bell blinking closer}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the lone tune returns over the oars; the last bar rocks straight back into the theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
